64:class CFTimeGrouper:
65:    """This is a simple container for the grouping parameters that implements a
66:    single method, the only one required for resampling in xarray.  It cannot
67:    be used in a call to groupby like a pandas.Grouper object can."""
68:

70:    closed: SideOptions

76:    def __init__(
77:        self,
78:        freq: ResampleCompatible | BaseCFTimeOffset,
79:        closed: SideOptions | None = None,
80:        label: SideOptions | None = None,
81:        origin: str | CFTimeDatetime = "start_day",
82:        offset: str | datetime.timedelta | BaseCFTimeOffset | None = None,
83:    ):
84:        self.freq = to_offset(freq)
85:        self.origin = origin
86:
87:        if isinstance(self.freq, MonthEnd | QuarterEnd | YearEnd):
88:            if closed is None:
89:                self.closed = "right"
90:            else:
91:                self.closed = closed
92:            if label is None:
93:                self.label = "right"
94:            else:
95:                self.label = label
96:        else:
97:            # The backward resample sets ``closed`` to ``'right'`` by default
98:            # since the last value should be considered as the edge point for
99:            # the last bin. When origin in "end" or "end_day", the value for a
100:            # specific ``cftime.datetime`` index stands for the resample result
101:            # from the current ``cftime.datetime`` minus ``freq`` to the current
102:            # ``cftime.datetime`` with a right close.
103:            if self.origin in ["end", "end_day"]:
104:                if closed is None:
105:                    self.closed = "right"
106:                else:
107:                    self.closed = closed
108:                if label is None:
109:                    self.label = "right"
110:                else:
111:                    self.label = label
112:            else:
113:                if closed is None:
114:                    self.closed = "left"
115:                else:
116:                    self.closed = closed
117:                if label is None:
118:                    self.label = "left"
119:                else:
120:                    self.label = label

125:            except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
126:                raise ValueError(
127:                    f"offset must be a datetime.timedelta object or an offset string "
128:                    f"that can be converted to a timedelta. Got {type(offset)} instead."
129:                ) from error
130:        else:
131:            self.offset = None

133:    def first_items(self, index: CFTimeIndex):
134:        """Meant to reproduce the results of the following
135:
136:        grouper = pandas.Grouper(...)
137:        first_items = pd.Series(np.arange(len(index)),
138:                                index).groupby(grouper).first()
139:
140:        with index being a CFTimeIndex instead of a DatetimeIndex.
141:        """
142:
143:        datetime_bins, labels = _get_time_bins(
144:            index, self.freq, self.closed, self.label, self.origin, self.offset
145:        )
146:        # check binner fits data
147:        if index[0] < datetime_bins[0]:
148:            raise ValueError("Value falls before first bin")
149:        if index[-1] > datetime_bins[-1]:
150:            raise ValueError("Value falls after last bin")
151:
152:        integer_bins = np.searchsorted(index, datetime_bins, side=self.closed)
153:        counts = np.diff(integer_bins)
154:        codes = np.repeat(np.arange(len(labels)), counts)
155:        first_items = pd.Series(integer_bins[:-1], labels, copy=False)
156:
157:        # Mask duplicate values with NaNs, preserving the last values
158:        non_duplicate = ~first_items.duplicated("last")
159:        return first_items.where(non_duplicate), codes

162:def _get_time_bins(
163:    index: CFTimeIndex,
164:    freq: BaseCFTimeOffset,
165:    closed: SideOptions,
166:    label: SideOptions,
167:    origin: str | CFTimeDatetime,
168:    offset: datetime.timedelta | None,
169:):
170:    """Obtain the bins and their respective labels for resampling operations.
171:
172:    Parameters
173:    ----------
174:    index : CFTimeIndex
175:        Index object to be resampled (e.g., CFTimeIndex named 'time').
176:    freq : xarray.coding.cftime_offsets.BaseCFTimeOffset
177:        The offset object representing target conversion a.k.a. resampling
178:        frequency (e.g., 'MS', '2D', 'H', or '3T' with
179:        coding.cftime_offsets.to_offset() applied to it).
180:    closed : 'left' or 'right'
181:        Which side of bin interval is closed.
182:        The default is 'left' for all frequency offsets except for 'M' and 'A',
183:        which have a default of 'right'.
184:    label : 'left' or 'right'
185:        Which bin edge label to label bucket with.
186:        The default is 'left' for all frequency offsets except for 'M' and 'A',
187:        which have a default of 'right'.
188:    origin : {'epoch', 'start', 'start_day', 'end', 'end_day'} or cftime.datetime, default 'start_day'
189:        The datetime on which to adjust the grouping. The timezone of origin
190:        must match the timezone of the index.
191:
192:        If a datetime is not used, these values are also supported:
193:        - 'epoch': `origin` is 1970-01-01
194:        - 'start': `origin` is the first value of the timeseries
195:        - 'start_day': `origin` is the first day at midnight of the timeseries
196:        - 'end': `origin` is the last value of the timeseries
197:        - 'end_day': `origin` is the ceiling midnight of the last day
198:    offset : datetime.timedelta, default is None
199:        An offset timedelta added to the origin.
200:
201:    Returns
202:    -------
203:    datetime_bins : CFTimeIndex
204:        Defines the edge of resampling bins by which original index values will
205:        be grouped into.
206:    labels : CFTimeIndex
207:        Define what the user actually sees the bins labeled as.
208:    """
209:
210:    if not isinstance(index, CFTimeIndex):
211:        raise TypeError(
212:            "index must be a CFTimeIndex, but got "
213:            f"an instance of {type(index).__name__!r}"
214:        )
215:    if len(index) == 0:
216:        datetime_bins = labels = CFTimeIndex(data=[], name=index.name)
217:        return datetime_bins, labels
218:
219:    first, last = _get_range_edges(
220:        index.min(), index.max(), freq, closed=closed, origin=origin, offset=offset
221:    )
222:    datetime_bins = labels = date_range(
223:        freq=freq, start=first, end=last, name=index.name, use_cftime=True
224:    )
225:
226:    datetime_bins, labels = _adjust_bin_edges(
227:        datetime_bins, freq, closed, index, labels
228:    )
229:
230:    labels = labels[1:] if label == "right" else labels[:-1]
231:    # TODO: when CFTimeIndex supports missing values, if the reference index
232:    # contains missing values, insert the appropriate NaN value at the
233:    # beginning of the datetime_bins and labels indexes.
234:
235:    return datetime_bins, labels

264:    of microseconds to the bin edges generated by cftime range, so that we do
265:    bin the value at noon on January 31st in the January bin.  This results in
266:    an index with bin edges like the following:
267:
268:    CFTimeIndex([1999-12-31 23:59:59, 2000-01-31 23:59:59,
